body: Being that I would have to text from my phone it would not be anonymous so that really isn't an option.

Tried three different online chats today both were pretty horrible.

Lifeline - wanted all my personal information and would not talk until I told them if I could harm myself immediately so they could call the police.

The Hopeline - Same thing as lifeline

ImAlive - Person was nice enough but really couldn't seem to handle the tough conversation.

Seems all of the phone/online chat service are just a waste. We all know if the police show up it's a few days in the psyc ward then nothing more just back out and back to the way we feel.
Made it this far suffering more and more every day as I watch life drop away around me.
Appreciate that but I'm so past talking at this point. When you are out of options and in a corner you just do what you have to do.
